proposed.text: How does the requirement for oath-taking and regular PIC renewal work together to maintain the integrity of the architectural profession?

options.text: They are unrelated administrative procedures with no professional significance, serving merely as bureaucratic formalities without impact on professional conduct
Oath commits architects to ethics; renewal verifies they maintain standing and compliance with professional standards
Both are voluntary measures that architects may choose to follow, with no mandatory enforcement or penalties for non-compliance
They serve only to generate revenue for the PRC, without any direct influence on the professional standards or ethical practices of architects

rationale.a: Dismisses safeguards as merely administrative; oath and renewal together enforce professional responsibility and accountability.
rationale.c: Contradicts legal structure; both oath and renewal are mandatory for practice authority, not voluntary options.
rationale.d: Reduces public interest safeguards to revenue collection; oath and renewal protect the public by ensuring ethical practitioners remain in good standing.
rationale.correct: The oath represents a binding commitment to the Code of Ethical Conduct and professional standards, while PIC renewal requires verification of continued standing and compliance. Together they ensure that only architects meeting ongoing ethical and professional requirements maintain practice authority.
rationale.takeaway: Oath + renewal: initial ethical commitment + ongoing verification of compliance = sustained profession integrity.
